confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are triangulated from several aggregator and blog sources (mostly 2023-2026) that mix town and hotel-zone prices, so they are bounded estimates. Cocktail rests on a few venue ranges rather than aggregates. wine_glass has no direct Tulum by-the-glass price; it is derived from the beer anchor at an assumed ratio of about 2.5x. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Tulum lodging. No accommodation search was run, no live listings were checked, and July demand can move room rates widely. The FX value comes from search results summarizing the RBA exchange-rate page; the F11.1 data file itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors reflect Tulum-specific aggregated price data, blending pueblo (town) and hotel-zone levels. Accommodation tiers are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Tulum's town and beach-zone lodging, loosely benchmarked against other Riviera Maya resort towns. Wine is derived from the beer relationship as described above.
